Here are two of our best value-for-money options, side by side:
Essentials Medium
Price: $159
What you get: 6 cuts, up to 21 lbs of meat
Selection: 50+ core cuts (ground beef, chicken breasts, pork chops, salmon, etc.) but no specialty cuts like ribeye, filet mignon, or scallops
Great if: You want premium basics at the lowest price per box.
Signature Medium
Price: $179
Selection: Everything in Essentials plus 30+ specialty cuts (ribeye, filet mignon, scallops, etc.)
Great if: You want maximum variety and higher-end cuts for just a bit more.
Both include:
Access to member deals, add-ons, recipe library, loyalty rewards, referrals, and free shipping on your subscription.
In plain terms, Essentials is like a killer deal on the everyday staples, while Signature Medium is a small price bump for access to the full “steakhouse & seafood” menu, which many members see as the best value upgrade.

The pricier Signature plan costs more but unlocks all cuts, including 30+ specialty items like ribeye, filet mignon, and scallops, and comes in multiple sizes (up to 42 lbs).
